clips.title: The story
paras: Stout to Kadrell is an Alliance delivery quest that leads travelers out of the frozen heights of Dun Morogh and into the temperate valley of Loch Modan. Entrusted with a cask of Rejold Barleybrew's newly perfected Shimmer Stout, you carry the potent brew across the territorial border to share with Mountaineer Kadrell on patrol in Thelsamar.

After tasting the newly finished Shimmer Stout created by his brother Rejold, Mountaineer Barleybrew is convinced it is too good to keep entirely within Dun Morogh. Stationed at the eastern border post guarding the mountain passes, Barleybrew looks out toward his kin guarding neighboring lands. Dwarven mountaineering can be a cold, grueling assignment, and a stout heart calls for stout drink. Wanting an honest appraisal from a fellow patrolman on the line, Barleybrew sends a cask eastward with passing travelers bound for Loch Modan.

The journey marks a natural rite of passage for young dwarven and gnomish adventurers who have spent their early days among the snowbound crags of Dun Morogh. Passing southeast through the South Gate Outpost and traversing the long tunnels cut through the mountain bedrock, travelers suddenly emerge into the warmer, wooded basin of Loch Modan. Patrolling along the road through the settlement of Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell gladly takes a break from his vigil to tap the cask, discovering that Barleybrew's new recipe has an astonishing kick.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff! I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it. His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road. Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.
Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, Shaman, and welcome to Thelsamar!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now, let me have a taste...
Magni's Beard! This stuff gets your head turning! And it lightens the limbs, too.
I feel like I can fly!
